baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain `amran min indina ... kunna mursilin` joins a payload, its point of origin, and an established sending subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: A matter that can also function as a directive originates in the speaker's presence and is released outward; `kunna` presents sending as an established mode rather than an isolated act.

The being-and-temporal-predication image turns sending into a standing temporal disposition.
The release-and-dispatch image supplies the outward vector that carries the sourced matter.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified command comes from the speaker, who sends.
changed_reading.after: An operative matter moves from the speaker's own presence into history through an established practice of release and dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular `amran` stands beside the durative-looking `kunna mursilin`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The one matter can be heard as one installment within repeated dispatches: the sender persists while payloads or carriers proceed successively.

activation_trace.role: The individual affair image lets this matter function as one unit in a larger series.

The successive-batches image organizes sending as repeated units moving one after another.

changed_reading.before: This verse reports one sending event.
changed_reading.after: This matter is one packet in a continuing, serial economy of dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `Amran` can activate an appointed sign or time, while `mursilin` supplies emission from `indina`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The matter is not only an instruction but a marked release point: a signal held at the source becomes effective when sent into its appointed interval.

activation_trace.role: The mark-or-appointed-time image gives the matter the function of a scheduled signal.

changed_reading.before: A directive is sent from the speaker.
changed_reading.after: A source-held appointment or signal is released into its effective time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Authority in `amr`, responsibility in `kawn`, and messenger/message in `mursilin` can align as a commission.
baseline_models.mechanism: An authority-originating mandate is placed under responsibility and borne as a commission by an envoy; this coexists with the simpler temporal use of `kunna`.

activation_trace.role: The authority-and-command-holder image supplies the mandate's governing source.
The presence image marks direct provenance rather than anonymous transmission.

changed_reading.after: A mandate with direct provenance is entrusted to a responsible bearer as an authorized commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence makes the focus matter the output of a pipeline: an ordinance is fixed, brought down, differentiated from a whole into distinct matters, perfected, and then dispatched from the source.

activation_trace.role: The directive image supplies an executable payload for the contextual production sequence.
Dispatch supplies the final outward stage after differentiation.
The fixing-that-entails-judgment image gives the pipeline a determinate written or decreed input.
The causing-to-descend-and-arrive image supplies transfer from source into the receiving domain.
The discrimination image supplies controlled differentiation rather than undirected scattering.
The encompassing-whole image supplies the total field from which each matter is distinguished.
The affair image explicitly links the differentiated contextual units to the focus payload.
The perfected-and-secured image makes each separated matter a finished, stable unit.

structural_cues: The focus `amran` immediately follows `yufraqu kullu amrin hakim`, allowing it to resume or specify the differentiated matter.
The order book, descent, differentiation, source, and sending supports a directional process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixing, descent, differentiation, totality, perfected matters, and dispatch; I supply the arrow that treats them as successive processing stages. A live alternative is that they are parallel descriptions of one revelation rather than a production pipeline.

changed_reading.before: A command is sent from the speaker.
changed_reading.after: A fixed ordinance is brought down, resolved into perfected executable matters, and released outward from its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing before the focus, mercy immediately after it, and gift near the close activate non-coercive branches in both `amr` and `irsal`: the dispatch can be productive beneficence as well as warning or rule.

activation_trace.role: The growth-and-blessing image turns the matter into something generative rather than merely coercive.

Mercy and tenderness identify the immediate effect or mode of the sourced dispatch.
The benefaction-and-gift image closes the arc by naming divine provision as a gift.

structural_cues: A blessed descent in 44:3 and `rahmatan min rabbika` in 44:6 bracket the focus.
The later `fadlan min rabbika` repeats the source construction with explicit benefaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blessing, mercy, gift, growth, and willing giving; I infer that these qualify the function of the focus dispatch. The live alternative is that mercy names only the revelation while the focus `amr` remains primarily decree or warning.

changed_reading.before: The focus transmits an authoritative directive.
changed_reading.after: The same authoritative transmission can be a growing gift: beneficence deliberately released from the source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing and knowing at the sender-side, followed by paired waiting at the close, activate reciprocal and deliberative branches in the focus: dispatch institutes a monitored relation rather than a one-way drop.

structural_cues: The sender is named as hearing and knowing immediately after the focus.
The surah closes with the same monitoring verb predicated across both sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, knowing, reciprocal matching, deliberation, and paired waiting; I infer a monitored correspondence created by dispatch, not a human message sent back to God. The live alternative is that the attributes and final waiting are independent of the mechanics of sending.

changed_reading.before: A source emits a message toward passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: Dispatch opens a watched, informed relation in which the source remains attentive and both sides occupy coordinated expectation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated contextual messengers embody the focus plural and strengthen its serial force: the enduring sender repeatedly places carried speech in human agents across distinct audiences and times.

structural_cues: A messenger appears for the immediate addressees and again inside the earlier Pharaoh narrative.
The focus uses a plural active participle after `kunna`, fitting an established practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated messenger occurrences in distinct narrative frames and the focus's temporal predication; I infer that these are samples of an ongoing sender-pattern. The live alternative is that the plural is generic while the two contextual messengers are merely separate examples.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns the present descent alone.
changed_reading.after: The present matter is one embodiment of a recurrent historical practice in which speech is repeatedly placed in messengers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger episode makes the exploratory commission model concrete: a mandate from authority is entrusted to an envoy, who must render a due trust and presents validating authority.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery of a trust, envoy identity, trustworthiness, and compelling authority; I supply the chain-of-custody relation back to the focus source. A live alternative is that these legal and fiduciary features belong only to the Moses episode and do not characterize every dispatch.

changed_reading.before: A command simply travels from sender to audience.
changed_reading.after: An authorized mandate moves through a traceable custody chain: source, entrusted envoy, validated authority, and performed obligation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night travel and the sea left as an open, smoothly traversable interval activate the motion branch of `irsal`: the sent command does not only move as speech; it sets people in motion and produces a passage.

structural_cues: The narrative moves from an imperative to travel by night directly to an imperative that leaves the sea open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a directive, night movement, an open interval, and smooth successive travel; I infer that dispatch causally becomes a traversable path. The live alternative is that movement is only a consequence of the message and does not qualify the focus verb itself.

changed_reading.before: Sending transfers words to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Sending can be operational: the directive releases its recipients into motion and opens the route by which they move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early differentiation of every matter and the later appointed Day of Separation that gathers everyone create a temporal routing model: distinct dispatches leave in batches, while an appointed terminus separates decisively and reassembles the dispersed field.

Making a boundary visible supplies the decisive terminal separation.

Gathering dispersed parts supplies reassembly at the appointed terminus.

Distribution and gathering are lexically opposed operations positioned at different temporal horizons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies early differentiation, serial sending, a fixed appointment, final separation, and gathering; I infer a routing cycle from distributed releases to terminal assembly. The live alternative is a thematic echo between two judgments without a single process connecting them.

changed_reading.before: The focus releases one appointed signal.
changed_reading.after: The focus occupies the outbound phase of a schedule: matters are differentiated and sent in succession toward a fixed separating-and-gathering terminus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing claim that the discourse is made easy in the addressee's language for recollection reveals a delivery layer inside sending: the carried matter is shaped for smooth reception, articulation, and retrieval.

Smooth easy movement supplies the delivery quality later made explicit as linguistic ease.
Ease after difficulty supplies deliberate accessibility for the transmitted matter.
Light, compliant movement models low-friction passage through the receiving medium.

Conveying a message by tongue directly identifies linguistic delivery as part of sending.

structural_cues: The pronoun in `yassarnahu` resumes the transmitted discourse, and the purpose clause points to recipient recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, compliant movement, language, message-conveyance, and recollection; I infer that adaptation to a receiving medium is an internal stage of dispatch. The live alternative is that ease concerns recitation alone and does not revise `mursilin`.

changed_reading.before: Sending ends when a message reaches an audience.
changed_reading.after: Sending includes interface design: the matter is fitted to human language so that it moves smoothly into speech and recoverable memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples two specialized material rows, a spear fitted with a point and a short-arrow use, with ordinary `amran` and `mursilin`. It remains anchored to both focus roots and yields a coherent payload-carrier analogy, but downstream prose must label it a branch-level material metaphor, not a proposed lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the `amr` payload directly before the identity of those who send it.

activation_trace.role: Fitting a shaft with a spearpoint supplies the literal payload-to-carrier joint and the role of making the dispatch incisive.
The specialized short-arrow row supplies a compact sent carrier that completes the material analogy.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command is fitted to its carrier like an incisive point, so dispatch is the assembly of payload and delivery instrument.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because resistance and sideward departure are remote branches from the prepositional `indina`. The reading remains anchored by contrasting those branches with the focus presence branch and with later turning-away and withdrawal, but it should be rendered only as an activated spatial-moral contrast, never as a replacement meaning for `indina`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `Min indina` locates the dispatch at a source whose root inventory also contains deviation and sideward resistance.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence supply the stable source-center of the contrast.
Deviation and resistance supply the opposed trajectory that the sourced matter confronts.
Sideward leaning supplies a spatial image for leaving the source-aligned course.
Turning away supplies a contextual enactment of the opposed direction.
Withdrawal to one side reinforces the contextual geometry of separation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the stable source-position also throws the recipients' sideward resistance into relief: the dispatch comes from alignment toward those turning away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because several livestock and milk-yield branches are form-distant from their actual words. Their convergence remains anchored to the focus growth and continuous-yield branches and to the final language-delivery scene, making a coherent material analogy for sustained provision. Downstream prose must call it an exploratory nourishment image and must not literalize revelation as milk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can pair growth or blessing in `amr` with continuous yield in `mursilin`.

activation_trace.role: Growth and blessing supply the nourishing value of what is sent.
Milk and continuous flow supply the material image of recurring beneficial yield.
Milk drawn from a kneeling camel supplies an early concrete yield image within the blessed descent.
Gift and benefaction keep the material flow oriented toward provision rather than mere abundance.
Yield and growth in livestock reinforce sustained production at the point where the discourse is made easy.
The milking image makes language the interface through which the nourishing yield is drawn and delivered.

changed_reading.before: Sending is the transfer of a bounded command.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sending is a renewable nourishing yield: beneficent content is drawn into language and made continuously available.

strongest_changes: The focus matter became the dispatched output of a fixed, descended, differentiated, and perfected decree-process.
Repeated messengers turned `kunna mursilin` into a recurrent historical practice rather than a single event.
The Moses sequence exposed a chain of custody and a path-opening operational effect, while 44:58 exposed linguistic adaptation as part of delivery.
The appointed Day of Separation revised the timed-signal baseline into a cycle of distribution, scheduling, separation, and gathering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several mechanisms at once: juridical decree, generous outflow, serial embodiment, entrusted commission, kinetic path-making, timed routing, and receiver-oriented language design. Branch-distant material alignments also produced contained spearpoint and nourishing-yield outliers that a conservative reading would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise syntactic force of focus `amran` may favor apposition, causation, specification, or another relation, changing how tightly the pipeline binds.
`Kunna` securely supplies temporal predication, but suretyship is only an exploratory branch activation and should not displace the auxiliary reading.
The responsive-correspondence model may overconnect divine hearing and final mutual waiting to the mechanics of sending.
The material outliers depend on convergent but form-distant branches and require explicit qualification.
